about: The lowest item price at any of a drive's offers in one condition, step by step, over 90 days up to now; an offer unchecked for longer than 7 days ends at its last check. Times are days ago. The backend's price ranges and the frontend's chart both read these steps, and both are tested against these cases.

cases.name: follows whichever store is cheapest, one step for as long as the lowest stays the same
leaves a gap while nothing is in stock, and an offer unchecked too long ends at its last check
ends on a price recorded this instant as a step of no length
has nothing when nothing was in stock
